## Summary

Replace the generic creator list with the remaining authored row and scrollbar layer.

```text
category → source-ordered rows, 20px pitch
           ├─ normal / rollover / selected / locked artwork + source text
           └─ fractional scroll model →119×182 mask
                arrows / handle + keyboard / wheel adapters
```

Use existing native rasters or mock numerical primitives, hide body costs, and retain source locked/affordability alpha and labels. The editor still owns chosen parts and placement. This follows merged #60/#61 and supplies the remaining runtime wiring from the original palette checkpoint.

## Evidence

- **Before:** Generic buttons/native browser scrolling cover part of the authored backdrop.
  **After:** Source mask/row geometry, font fields, colours, indicators, mirrored arrows and handle poses drive the visible list.
- Source: TankCreatorScreen row construction4664–4712, release selection `_-40/_-Jo`, scrolling `_-I/ScrollJump2Percentage/_-7c/_-3u` and scrollbar stage ownership. Preserve120px arrow range vs121 drag divisor,18…138 clamp and fractional positioning rather than rounding away source offsets.
- Selected rows ignore reactivation. Disabled controls ignore input; lost capture/cancel stops held scrolling, while ordinary release preserves hover paint. Wheel/keyboard are explicit usability adapters. The scoped wheel listener and owned StrictMode fixture clean up on unmount.
- Formatting, TypeScript,496 rule tests (6,102 assertions), production build and all ten affected browser cases pass in2.1 minutes, without skips. Final native/mock paint recapture cases pass31.8s; enabled/disabled/locked captures inspected.
- Browser evidence covers physical fractional row position, release from an outside-origin press, normal-release paint, capture loss, drag/arrow/keyboard/wheel input, category reset, body cost hiding, locked frame/text/both alpha factors, single wheel step, preview clipping, affordability/rejection and in-game cancellation. QA clears document-selection highlighting caused by its deliberately outside-origin press.
- Generated data/native caches remain unchanged; optional FontInfo.leading reflects an already parsed field. Source stats/text/core metadata/importers still match the original checkpoint byte for byte.
- Rollover details, advanced enemy statistics, full input/constructor timing and original-screen comparison remain pending. Mock contours/fonts and rectangular browser hit targets remain explicit boundaries. No original media or saved-design schema changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the generic list and browser scrollbar.

**Blast Radius:** editor

Shared palette rows change across creator entry paths. Simulation and saved designs retain their existing contracts.
